verdict.rationale: Cake's capital-raise feature says founders can raise SAFEs and Convertible Notes in one workflow with digital signing and investor communication. A full contract editor covers SAFEs and Convertibles. SAFEs and notes appear on the live cap table, which the MCP integration can query, and raise modelling shows dilution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conversion-term modelling (valuation cap, discount, interest, conversion into a priced round), detail on the send/e-sign flow for SAFEs specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
